svg.title: Supported duals and continuous global sections
svg.desc: Compact supported perfect modules have supported tensor duals. Their telescope vanishing gives exact agreement between ordinary and continuous global sections. Full generator bars identify the tensor pairing with categorical evaluation and the actual diagonal with coevaluation. Formal-disc sections and an affine product comparison distinguish these statements from a unit adjunction.
svg.text: The tensor pairing determines the continuous unit dual
Complex numbers; reductive H; actual restricted quotient; modules unbounded both ways.
1. Compact objects have actual supported perfect duals — SDU.1–SDU.3
Finite generator cells and retracts: every compact P is perfect over B at one support E.
P* = RHom over B from P to B; P*[g⁻¹] = (P[g⁻¹])* = 0 for g in I(E).
Coevaluation: C(S) → B → P ⊗ P*. Evaluation: P* ⊗ P → C(S) → B.
The full support coreflection supplies the evaluation factorization and its coherences.
P** = P; compact tensor duals exist although C(S) need not be compact.
2. Compactness controls the entire inverse product tower — SDU.4–SDU.7
P[g⁻¹] = 0 and perfect P ⇒ gᴺ : P → P is nullhomotopic for some finite N.
RHom(B[g⁻¹],P) = fib(1−T : product P → product P), Tᴺ ≃ 0.
(1−T)(1+T+⋯+Tᴺ⁻¹) = 1−Tᴺ ≃ 1; hence the whole fibre vanishes.
P ≃ RHom(C(F),P) for F ⊃ E. These are the counit-induced maps on the H nerve.
Cofinality and full Reynolds contraction: Pᴴ ≃ Hom in A from 1(A) to P.
3. Continuous global sections extend the compact values — SDU.8–SDU.9
Γ!(M) = (underlying supported B-module M)ᴴ.
Exact rational invariants and underlying modules preserve all colimits.
Γ! → Γ is an equivalence on compacts; their full bars determine Γ! uniquely.
Derived balancing gives a non-unital right-lax symmetric monoidal structure.
4. The actual pairing and diagonal are both identified — SDU.10–SDU.13
Evaluation: (M,N) ↦ Γ!(M ⊗ over B with N).
For compact P: Γ!(P* ⊗ M) = RHom in A from P to M.
Thus the compact duals correspond exactly to all representable continuous functionals.
Coevaluation K = δ(A)(1) = (L ⊗ L)(Rᵣ) = the actual diagonal pushforward.
Hom(P ⊠ Q,K) = Hom(Q,P*): this is the full diagonal DG bimodule.
Both triangles are enriched Yoneda bar contractions, including every derived degree.
5. Two exact tests separate continuous duality from adjunction — SDU.14–SDU.16
Formal disc: unit = fib(C[t] → C[t,t⁻¹]).
Continuous sections: H¹ = t⁻¹C[t⁻¹]. Ordinary sections: H⁰ = C[[t]].
On the compact generator C both sections functors are C in degree zero.
Affine polynomial algebra: u(V) = C[t] ⊗ V; its continuous dual forgets the action.
u(product C) → product u(C) misses the sequence (tⁿ): no uniform degree bound.
Thus u has no left adjoint, although its continuous dual exists.
No finite-dimensional global-cohomology assumption is imposed on the tensor proof.
Exact proofs: §§3.180–3.185, SDU.1–SDU.16; Solutions3.DE–3.DF.
Continuous-global-section framework: AGKRRV, arXiv:2010.01906v2.
